generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A new delivery can inherit a ready artifact from its base and mistakenly treat path existence or internal validity as proof that the artifact was produced for the current target.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Reuse the existing handoff or specification snapshot without comparing immutable-base object identity and without binding repository, work item, pull request and branch subject.
trigger_signals: existing result artifact at delivery start
candidate artifact identical to immutable base
artifact subject differs from resolved target

reusable_control.purpose: Reject inherited or foreign result artifacts before any evidence reuse.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Resolve the target first, compare current result artifacts against the immutable base, and force a fresh package when origin or subject binding is foreign.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Audit target binding and immutable-base object identity independently before accepting a ready certificate as current delivery evidence.

transfer_cases.observed: A foreign inherited specification snapshot is rejected before requirement reuse.
A base-identical foreign handoff certificate is classified as inherited state rather than current output.

skill_changes.change: Target binding rejects inherited foreign specification artifacts before reuse.
skill_changes.evidence: entregar-issue delivery-target-binding and handoff-recovery regression suite passed.

skill_changes.change: Independent handoff origin check distinguishes base-identical foreign certificates from current delivery output.
skill_changes.evidence: auditar-issue immutable-base handoff-origin regression suite passed.
